Here is one I solve step by step. Sentence: I eat ___ egg. Step 1: I look at the next word, "egg". Step 2: it starts with an "e" sound. Step 3: so I choose "an": I eat an egg.
The rule: use an before a, e, i, o, u sounds, and a before other sounds.
Right: I have a pen. Wrong: I have an pen.
Now it is your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
